summary: The test compiles and uses Playwright APIs correctly, but the test assertion is minimal with a weak selector that may not robustly verify the contact form accessibility. The test case ID is not referenced in the test title, missing traceability. The selector '[data-test="nav-contact"]' may be fragile without context. The test only verifies visibility of a navigation element, not the contact form or its accessibility.

issues.description: Test title does not include the related testCaseId 'TC-001', which reduces traceability between manual and automated tests.
issues.recommendation: Include the testCaseId in the test title to clearly link the automated test with the manual test case.

issues.description: The selector '[data-test="nav-contact"]' verifies visibility of a navigation item, but the test does not assert the actual presence or accessibility of the contact form on the page.
issues.recommendation: Improve the selector to target the actual contact form elements or headings to more strongly verify the page loaded correctly.

issues.description: The assertion checks visibility of a navigation element rather than accessibility or presence of the contact form itself, limiting coverage.
issues.recommendation: Add assertions that verify key form elements or accessibility attributes to make the test more meaningful.

recommendations: Add the testCaseId (TC-001) in the test title for better traceability.
Enhance selectors to directly verify the contact form elements rather than a navigation item.
Add stronger assertions verifying accessibility or existence of key form fields within the contact page.
